title: Provision of Power Supply, DG set and Servo Stabilizer for Elevator at Beypore Lighthouse
summary: E-tender for power supply works, a DG set and a servo stabilizer for the elevator at Beypore Lighthouse, Kerala, tendered by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

sites.name: Beypore Lighthouse
sites.work: Power supply, DG set and servo stabilizer for elevator

scope.item: Provision of Power Supply for Elevator

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any Nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; original EMD by 17.11.2025 15:00 (one day before bid submission end). Small Scale Industries with valid NSIC/MSME certificate exempt from EMD.

eligibility: Reputed OEMs or their authorized suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties or Government undertakings
notes: Scanned Section 1 NIT only; no BOQ, DG set rating or completion period. Bid download/submission 04.11.2025 11:00 to 18.11.2025 15:00; technical bid opening 19.11.2025 16:00. Notice calls itself a short tender notice in note 4.
